request.style: English, male folk voice, solo with warm acoustic guitar, soft hand percussion, gentle cello, flute, mellow mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He sat by the well in the land of Midian
Seven daughters came to fill the troughs
Shepherds drove them away in the heat
Moses rose up to water their flock
Reuel asked why they returned so soon
An Egyptian had rescued their day
Invite him to eat, said the father
Zipporah became his wife that way

[Chorus]
Blessed be the LORD who rescued you
From the hand of Pharaoh and Egypt
Now I know the LORD is greater
Than all gods who rule the earth

[Verse]
Go in peace, Jethro said to Moses
Return to your relatives in Egypt
But he came back to the mountain of God
With Zipporah and their two sons
Gershom, a stranger in a foreign land
Eliezer, the God of his father
Jethro rejoiced over the good of God
He saw the rescue from the Egyptians

[Chorus]
Blessed be the LORD who rescued you
From the hand of Pharaoh and Egypt
Now I know the LORD is greater
Than all gods who rule the earth

[Bridge]
You judge the people from morning till evening
This task is too heavy for you alone
Look out for capable men who fear God
Trustworthy men who hate a bribe
Appoint them over thousands and hundreds
Fifties and tens to judge the people
Lighten your load and let them carry it
And all these people will go home in peace

[Chorus]
Blessed be the LORD who rescued you
From the hand of Pharaoh and Egypt
Now I know the LORD is greater
Than all gods who rule the earth

[Outro]
Moses listened and did everything he said
Then he sent his father-in-law home
